description: The Renovate preset of the repositories of dan-petty that keep Kubernetes manifests under k8s/. A repository extends it with github>dan-petty/infra//renovate/k8s, next to github>dan-petty/infra//renovate/base. The kubernetes manager reads each manifest under k8s/, the argocd manager each Argo CD Application under k8s/argocd/, and the helm-values manager each values file under k8s/. Each pin of dan-petty/infra moves in one pull request. The managers of Renovate read each consumer form of a pin of infra (dan-petty/infra, tests/renovate/), so the preset has no custom manager for them.

customManagers.description: The PostgreSQL image of a CloudNativePG Cluster (spec.imageName), which the kubernetes manager does not read. The pattern reads only an imageName field at the indent of spec, so a deeper imageName field, such as one in Helm values, stays out.

packageRules.description: A custom manager of a file under k8s/ updates the cluster.

Renovate reads an Application source with no chart as a git dependency. An environment that tracks the branch main stays on main, so Renovate leaves such a source alone. A source at a release tag, such as a pin of dan-petty/infra, gets its updates.
Each pin of dan-petty/infra (a Kustomize remote, an OpenTofu module, an Ansible collection, an Argo CD source and a reusable workflow) moves to a new release tag in one pull request.
